name: Cryogenic comminution of whole passenger-car waste tyres: complete LN2 immersion (200-300 s, below Tg = 215 K) followed by a single pneumatic-hammer impact
plain_name: Freeze a whole scrap car tyre in liquid nitrogen until it turns glassy, then smash it into rubber crumb
description: One-piece waste passenger tyres (modelled as 185 mm wide, 75% profile, 13 inch landing diameter) are fully immersed in liquid nitrogen in a purpose-built vessel until intense boiling stops (200-300 s), taking the rubber below its 215 K glass transition, and are then shattered by an MA4129A pneumatic sledgehammer with profiled punches; crumb size distribution is reported.
keywords: Freeze a whole scrap car tyre in liquid nitrogen until it turns glassy, then smash it into rubber crumb

sources.citation: A Multifaceted Approach for Cryogenic Waste Tire Recycling (Yerezhep, Tychengulova, Sokolov, Aldiyarov; Polymers 2021, 13(15):2494), doi:10.3390/polym13152494

reported_equipment: pneumatic sledgehammer of type MA4129A (LLC South Ural Mechanical Plant)
special vessel for complete liquid-nitrogen immersion of tyres

requirements.rationale: The tyre is cooled by complete immersion in a liquid-nitrogen bath.
The rubber must be taken below its glass-transition temperature (215 K) so it shatters instead of deforming; the cooling medium must reach below 215 K.
The whole tyre goes into the vessel; its 13 inch landing (rim) diameter is a lower bound on the clear diameter needed (the outer diameter, with the 75% x 185 mm sidewall on each side, is larger).
Optional: the immersion lasted up to 300 s depending on tyre mass and wall thickness.

confirmation_note: Requirements taken from the cited procedure and independently re-verified against the source (research/v4, 2026-11-01). Users must confirm them for their own run; edits require confirmation again.
